papers_reviewed.title: A Review of Large Language Models for Stock Price Forecasting from a Hedge-Fund Perspective
papers_reviewed.summary: Practitioner-focused pitfall review: sentiment fragility, data leakage, illiquidity premia, horizon mismatch. Directly applicable to H174 pre-live audit.

papers_reviewed.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
papers_reviewed.summary: Factor-axis tokenization: each factor is a token, transformer learns pairwise factor interactions (momentum × vol, value × sector). Bias correction reduces overfitting. Direct H188 upgrade → H194.

papers_reviewed.title: STORM: A Spatio-Temporal Factor Model Based on Dual Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoders for Financial Trading
papers_reviewed.summary: Dual VQ-VAE enforces orthogonality between time-series and cross-sectional factors. Published at top venue (WSDM '26). More complex than H194 — queue as H195 contingent on H194 first.

papers_reviewed.title: Can Large Language Models Trade? Testing Financial Theories with LLM Agents in Market Simulations
papers_reviewed.summary: LLM agents in simulated market with real order book. Finds consistent strategy adherence (value/momentum/market-making) and realistic price dynamics. More theoretical — no direct implementation hook for current pipeline.

papers_reviewed.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
papers_reviewed.summary: Single FC layer learns both TS and CS momentum jointly. Older paper — subsumed by STORM architecture. Already covered in short-term-reversal.md cross-reference.

repos_reviewed.summary: Production-ready quant system: FinBERT/GPT sentiment dynamically adjusts factor weights before monthly rebalance. Claims 70% post-earnings drift capture. Pattern is novel for our pipeline.
Curated paper list for stock prediction across KDD/WWW/AAAI/ACL. Useful reference tracker — no direct implementation.
Curated list of quant AI resources. Already aware of most listed items.

null_results.pairs_cointegration_llm: No strong 2025-2026 paper combining LLM with statistical cointegration-based pairs trading. The LLM+pairs angle remains an open research gap — LLMs can scaffold basic pairs infrastructure but don't yet outperform Engle-Granger systematically. Market-Bench (arXiv:2512.12264) tested LLMs on pairs (Coke/Pepsi) and found they struggle with price/inventory reasoning.
null_results.pead_new_signals_2026: PEAD.txt methodology was already staged 2026-05-11 (proposal 1). No substantially new PEAD+text paper found beyond what was staged yesterday. The ACL 2025 FinNLP paper on 'Enhancing PEAD Measurement with Large...' is closely related but appears to recapitulate PEAD.txt findings.
